items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Florence Mills, Cora Green, and my aunt. There were three women singing there.

ctx.x: Olive. You would have asked that, wait a minute. Harry Mattsengill was a trombone player. I don't know whether it was his band or the, see they had funny combinations and they had trombone and a four piece combination. Yes. Gordon was playing piano in this band? Uh-huh. Maybe my aunt could help me out because she was working the courses to do this. There ain't no way to help them out. She was singing there, huh? Yeah. Singing and dancing there. Singing and dancing there. Florence Mills was too. Oh yeah? Yes, wait…
Jesse Crump? No. Oh no, not him. What kind of a guy was you little at that time? Full of notoriety. Full of notoriety.
